metadata.title: fix(rust): resolve macOS path canonicalization in filesystem-server tests
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary
Fixes 3 failing tests in `mcp-servers/rust/filesystem-server` caused by macOS path canonicalization where `/var` symlinks to `/private/var`.

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
Run `cargo test` in `mcp-servers/rust/filesystem-server` on macOS. Tests fail with path mismatches (`/var/...` vs `/private/var/...`).

## 🐞 Root Cause
`fs::canonicalize()` resolves symlinks, converting `/var` to `/private/var` on macOS. Test assertions compared non-canonicalized expected paths with canonicalized actual paths.

## 💡 Fix Description
Updated test assertions to canonicalize expected paths before comparison in:
- `sandbox.rs`: `test_new_valid_root`, `test_resolve_path_inside_root`
- `read.rs`: `test_read_file_no_file`, `test_read_file_bigger_than_max_size`
- `integration_test.rs`: Three workflow tests

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Unit tests                            | `cargo test`         | ✅ 71 passed |
| Integration tests                     | `cargo test`         | ✅ 9 passed |

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (Rust auto-format)
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed

commits.message:
fix: resolve macOS path canonicalization issues in filesystem-server tests

On macOS, temporary directories are created under /var, which is a symlink
to /private/var. When fs::canonicalize() is called, it resolves symlinks,
causing test assertions to fail when comparing paths.

Changes:
- Updated sandbox.rs tests to use canonicalized paths for comparison
- Fixed read.rs tests to expect canonicalized paths in error messages
- Updated integration tests to canonicalize temp_dir paths before use

All 71 unit tests and 9 integration tests now pass on macOS.

Signed-off-by: Luca <lucarlig@protonmail.com>
